scope: Shared renderer HDC owned in Rust; checked owner and operation IDs, null setup/deletion, whole native text/path operation serialization separate from Rust document admission.

unsafe_boundary.limitations: Lexical inventory plus source review; not a proof that all remaining native code is memory-safe.

limits: Creator thread must outlive the shared DC; no worker thread or automatic cross-thread lifetime extension is introduced.

Outer adapter gate serializes complete text/path calls and font destruction. Rust operation tokens exclude overlapping operations and owner changes, but concurrent/reentrant host behavior remains unclosed.
C++ text/path control flow, raw PathData buffers, renderer graphs and host adapters remain transitional.
Null DC constructor/setup/destructor behavior is covered; later font creation on null DC or with no live renderer owner retains an unresolved-refusal qualification.
Scripted finite failures do not establish allocator exhaustion, arbitrary GDI failure combinations or host callback compatibility.
Historical storage retains its original upstream reference and implicit-assignment seam; not cleanup floating-assignment parity.
No production default switched; all host interfaces and vendored code remain in the full Rust objective.
